title: HySpawn
description: A lightweight, Folia-compatible spawn management plugin with configurable countdowns, void spawn rescue, sounds, and full MiniMessage support.
body:
# HySpawn

A simple yet powerful spawn management plugin built for modern Paper, Folia, and Canvas servers.

## Features

**Global Spawn**
Set a server-wide spawn point where new players land instantly on first join — no teleport flash, no delay. Players also respawn here on death.

**Spawn Command**
`/spawn` comes with a fully configurable countdown displayed via PacketEvents actionbar. If a player moves during the countdown, the teleport is cancelled. Admins can bypass both the countdown and the cooldown between uses.

**Void Spawn**
Set per-world rescue points for players who fall into the void. The plugin detects void falls before damage is dealt and teleports the player back safely.

**Fully Configurable**
Every message supports MiniMessage formatting — gradients, colors, bold, hover events, you name it. Sounds for teleportation, countdown ticks, and cancellation are all configurable with volume and pitch control.

**Folia & Canvas Ready**
Built with UniversalScheduler for full Folia/Canvas compatibility. No Bukkit scheduler calls, no thread issues.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/setspawn` | Set the global spawn at your location |
| `/spawn` | Teleport to spawn with countdown |
| `/setvoidspawn` | Set void rescue point for current world |
| `/unsetspawn` | Remove the global spawn |
| `/unsetvoidspawn [world]` | Remove void spawn for a world |
| `/hyspawn reload` | Reload config without restart |

## Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `hyspawn.admin` | Admin commands (set/unset/reload) | OP |
| `hyspawn.spawn` | Use /spawn | Everyone |
| `hyspawn.bypass.countdown` | Skip teleport countdown | OP |
| `hyspawn.bypass.cooldown` | Skip command cooldown | OP |

## Dependencies

- **Paper 1.21.11+** (or Folia / Canvas)
- **PacketEvents** 2.12.1+
